_comment: XFuel Protocol — MCP Tool Descriptor for Theta EdgeCloud MCP Server
_registration: Submit via POST /tools to your Theta MCP server endpoint, or run scripts/register-mcp-tool.cjs

tools.name: xfuel_submit_intent
tools.description: Submit an AI inference intent to the XFuel Protocol DePIN router. Routes to Theta EdgeCloud first (THETA_NATIVE), then Akash, Render, or AWS Bedrock as fallback. Every job is settled on-chain with a ZK proof and provenance attestation. Returns a task_id for status polling and an optional webhook delivery.

preset.description: Inference preset. One of: llm_chat, image_gen, speech_to_text, voice_clone, rag_query, video_process, object_detection

gpu_tier.description: GPU hardware tier. rtx4090 = 1x cost, a100 = 2x, h100 = 4x

prompt.description: Input prompt or query for the model. Required for llm_chat, rag_query, image_gen.

model.description: Model override. Defaults to preset default. Examples: llama-3.1-70b, flux-schnell, whisper-large-v3

max_tokens.description: Max output tokens for LLM inference. Default: 1024

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for LLM inference (0.0–1.0). Default: 0.7

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL. XFuel will POST the settled result here when the ZK proof is ready.

sender.description: Optional Theta wallet address of the requesting agent (for on-chain attribution).

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this inference job. Use with xfuel_poll_status.

status.description: Current job status: processing | completed | settled | failed

result.description: Inference result (present when status=completed). Shape depends on preset.

provider.description: Which DePIN network executed the job: THETA_NATIVE | DEPIN_AKASH | DEPIN_RENDER | HYBRID_CLOUD

on_chain.description: On-chain settlement details (present after ZK proof).

input.prompt: Explain Theta EdgeCloud DePIN architecture in two sentences.
Futuristic decentralized GPU network visualization, cinematic lighting
Summarize the XFuel whitepaper key points.

tools.name: xfuel_poll_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a previously submitted XFuel inference intent. Returns current status, result (if complete), and on-chain settlement details.

tools.name: xfuel_router_status
tools.description: Get the current health and configuration of the XFuel DePIN router. Shows which providers are active, per-tier call statistics, and the current dynamic boost multiplier.

mode.description: Active routing mode: LIVE | RAPIDAPI | AKASH | RENDER | BEDROCK | MOCK

providers.description: Per-tier enabled/disabled status and call stats
